intro.title: Explore Plaza de la Hispanidad or Spain
intro.description: Plaza de la Hispanidad or Spain (also known as Plaza de España o de la Hispanidad) is located at C. La Atarazana 2, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. It is a beautiful urban park with significant historical and cultural importance, and is a favorite leisure place for local residents and tourists. The park has become an important public space in Santo Domingo with its beautiful environment and important cultural value.

visitGuide.title: Visiting Tips
items: Bring a camera to capture the park's beautiful scenery and historical architecture
Respect local culture and historical sites

alsoKnownAs.title: Highlights
items: Significant Historical Importance: The square has important historical and cultural value and is an important place to understand Dominican history.
Beautiful Environment: The park has spacious leisure spaces and beautiful landscapes, making it an ideal place to relax.
Convenient Location: Located in the city center of Santo Domingo with convenient transportation.
Cultural Value: As Spain Square, it has important cultural significance and symbolic value.

route.title: Tour Route
route.overview: The ideal route to explore Plaza de la Hispanidad or Spain:
steps: Start at the main entrance at C. La Atarazana 2.
Walk along the paths and enjoy the park's landscapes and cultural elements.
Rest in the leisure areas and feel the local lifestyle.
Take photos of the park's beautiful scenery and historical architecture.
supplements: It's recommended to go during the day when the light is best for taking photos.
Pay attention to the park's opening hours and arrange your itinerary reasonably.
Please take care of the park environment and take your garbage with you.

transport.title: Transportation
transport.airportDesc: It is relatively close to Santo Domingo Airport. It is recommended to take a taxi or public transportation after arriving in the city.
transport.selfDriveDesc: Located in the city center of Santo Domingo. It is recommended to use navigation. There may be parking areas nearby.
transport.busDesc: You can take public transportation in Santo Domingo to nearby areas, but please pay attention to the schedule.
transport.intercityDesc: There are walking paths in the park, walkable to various areas.

officialManagement.title: About Plaza de la Hispanidad or Spain
officialManagement.text: Plaza de la Hispanidad or Spain is a famous urban park in Santo Domingo, featuring beautiful landscapes and rich cultural value. It is directly managed and maintained by the Santo Domingo National District City Hall.

historyTimeline.title: Historical Timeline

items.title: Early Period: Square Construction
items.description: The construction of Plaza de la Hispanidad or Spain aimed to provide a beautiful public leisure space for Santo Domingo citizens, and has long been regarded as an important urban public space by local residents.

items.title: 20th Century: Facility Improvement
items.description: With the development of Santo Domingo, the square gradually improved walking paths and leisure facilities, becoming an important place for citizens' leisure and entertainment.

items.title: 21st Century: Urban Landmark
items.description: Entering the 21st century, with its beautiful environment and important cultural value, it has attracted more tourists and become an important urban public space in Santo Domingo.

historyTimeline.guideContent: When visiting, you can start by strolling from the main entrance at C. La Atarazana 2; then walk around the square to enjoy the landscapes and cultural elements; if you have enough time, you can rest in the leisure areas and feel the local urban life. Finally, explore the urban scenery around the square and feel the charm of the Dominican capital.
